WALLET FORK CLOSED — SENTINEL IS NEVER GIVEN OUT, ALWAYS OURS
They host the compute, we keep the meter. They resell our credit unit for our service at their own rate. No forked ledger, no per-tenant Sentinel, no wallet in the takeout. Recorded on BEB-6800.

6804 CONSEQUENCE — a moved instance still calls Sentinel over the network
That call path surviving the move is an ACCEPTANCE item, not an assumption. Sentinel unreachable degrades by name, RATE UNAVAILABLE, settlement disabled — never a local fallback ledger.

NO PII ON CREDIT USE — ledger rows carry a KEY, never a person
Key, worker, reason, activity, markup, amount, timestamp, period. No name, email, IP, UA, or prompt text. CRM holds the person, ledger holds the key, they join at read time under auth. Never a copy.

RULING ON RECORD, NOT SPECCED — no PII on credit use
Alex 2026-08-28, deferred by him. Recorded on BEB-3895. Nobody designs against it yet; it pulls against 3898 live usage and the coop attribution requirement, and that tension is his to settle later.

BEB-6786 — worker-in-red half deployed both sides (Fable m65838 order done).
- DISPATCHER c002212d: recordExternal accepts `node` and passes it to the attempts INSERT (was node=lane.target=repo). Additive, backward-compatible.
- MASTRA 5f520d87: the deployStep record now sends node=<deployed worker name>. So deploy reds group under the WORKER (abilifi-payload/registry/etc), not alexrollin/abilifi-apps.
- Plus the fail-loud resolver (9adce213 earlier): a monorepo node never substitutes an orky file; owner/repo@subdir -> subdir source (one rule, both callers with the frag-door).
ACCEPTANCE now testable on new failures: a REPEAT_FAILER carries the worker -> self_heal_apply resolves that worker's source -> diff. Watching state for the next deploy fail to confirm it groups by worker; not claiming done until the diff lands. Remaining send-sites (complete stage, other deploy records) get node the same way if their worker is in scope — iterative, named.

ALL-LOOPS CONFORMANCE PASS RUN — ten loops, ONE passes. Table on BEB-3856
The loops that ANSWER are healthy; the loops that ACT are not. Five are not fireable from chat at all. One fix line each on the ticket. Criteria 1 and 3 unevidenced and not claimed.

Retrieve Alex's rulings, the spec-question log, the search log, the named-practice docs. Never generated specs, never the graph. Blocked by BEB-6779 or it retrieves an incomplete corpus silently.

BEB-267/249 already spec vrm_size, vrm_view, vrm_expression, layout and mood presets, narrator strip, fixed VRM across transitions. The newscast is Endash driven by a kairon playlist instead of slides. 267 fronted.

Every cut derives from a kairon; same event renders the same cuts twice. Blocked by 6733 truncation, 6772 WebGL capture, and an UNDECIDED audio path — a newscast with no voice is a silent film.

No fixtures, no seeded runs; a run with no kairons shows a named EMPTY. Every render logged with variety, task_id, cost and artefact key. A release carries its viz through evidence_ref.

SUBTITLES COME FROM THE PLAYLIST, NOT FROM AUDIO — so v1 ships captions-only
Timed-text sidecar every render, burn-in as an option never the only output. This takes the undecided audio path off the critical path. Not to be confused with burning a FEED to subscribers — that is 1936.

Same three layers, live instead of rendered: the variety becomes the SET, presenters become the PARTICIPANTS, the kairon layer becomes the PANEL FURNITURE — agenda item, who has the floor, vote tally.

CHROMEBOOK DECIDES THE STACK — browser only, tracking runs LOCAL, only rig data leaves
No OBS, no VSeeFace, no install. No camera image on the wire, which is the privacy product and removes the GDPR weight. Capability probe before the call; nobody is dropped from their own buurt meeting by a GPU.

Every cue is an event, so furniture, minutes, subtitles and the recording all derive from one source with no editing pass. QR carries session and item, NEVER a credential — photographed off screen it grants nothing.

THESIS ON BEB-6823: GOVERNANCE AS ENTERTAINMENT AND SOCIAL ACTIVITY
The show format IS the participation mechanism, so production quality is a requirement not polish. Metric is attendance, never views. Hard line: entertainment shapes the format and never the facts.

THE TWIN IS THE LARGER CONTEXT — the show is a VIEW onto it, the meeting is a WRITE to it
A vote does not produce a video, it changes the twin; the video is the byproduct. And the twin is the existing touch graph with buurt entity types, GERS-keyed — not a new store. Anyone proposing a twin database is proposing the defect.

OPINIONS ARE GERS-TAGGED AND RIDE THE BUURT SUBSTACK — the PLACE is the thread
An agenda item arrives with everything ever said about that place already attached. Same comment store as 6797/6807 with a place as target — no forum, no second feed. Refusal at write time: a place-tagged opinion cannot attach to a private home.

Their name, their domain, no powered-by anywhere a resident sees. The cut continues as the markup because Sentinel never leaves — so transfer costs us nothing, which is what makes it a real promise. Markup stays its own line or patronage is unauditable.

COMMONING ACTUALIZED — recorded on BEB-3895. Three member flows, apportioned not netted
Patronage returns markup on your own TRADE. Dividend is a return on CAPITAL. Buy-out accrues utilisation until the coop owns 100%. All three come out of the same markup line, so each is its own visible line or the books are unauditable.

PATRONAGE HAS ZERO TICKETS IN THE ESTATE — searched, nothing. BEB-6834 P0 fixes that
Ranked most important for weeks, described endlessly, never computed once. 6834 produces ONE REAL NUMBER from live rows. Not a schema programme, not double entry, no children.

6834 NEEDS THREE THINGS AND NOTHING ELSE: markup as its own stored line, a member on every row, a period
Then patronage is a sum and a ratio. Defaults set so nothing waits: monthly cycle, buy-out slice first, payout is a later ticket. Not blocked on statuten, notary or double entry.

Member sees patronage returned; non-member sees what would have come back. Membership being the better deal stops being a claim on a page and becomes a number from their own rows. Added to BEB-6834.

sentinel.abilifi.net IS 530 — fourth unbound hostname today, same class
abc, abilifi-abcms, abilifi-memplug, sentinel: all 530. www, app and the apex answer, and abilifi.net/health returns 200 so the Sentinel worker is alive — the subdomain has no route bound. BEB-2702 raised to P0.

One unbound-hostname fix likely clears the blog, the ABCMS renderer, memplug and the Sentinel panel together. Not four faults, one class. Front it ahead of the surface work that depends on it.

SENTINEL IS THE BILLING REPORTING APP — GCP billing-account model. That settles the wallet key
The wallet key is the BILLING ACCOUNT, its own object; sites, orgs and apps attach to it. Not tenantId, not site, not org. Transfer becomes an attachment change, not a migration. Invoices served and kept there; corrections are credit notes, never edits.

AND BILLING ROLES ARE SEPARATE FROM APP ROLES — which is the co-owner accountant
A billing admin sees invoices, spend and patronage without holding admin on the org or the app. Same shape lets a client's bookkeeper in without giving them the client's app. Patronage computes PER BILLING ACCOUNT.

THE ROOT IS THE IDENTITY — handle above billing account above attached things. Both names now picked
The handle is the Google account, the billing account is the Cloud billing account, sites and apps are the projects. One sign-in, many roles. The root survives transfer, so a resident keeps their handle when the buurt's system moves.
